keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks the Atabegs of Yazd). The page says the dynasty 'ruled the city of Yazd from approximately 1141 to 1319' and names no other territory except Kerman in a Marco Polo passage (not a possession). Drawn as the 65 km disc at Yazd that the kakuyids dossier uses for the same land; Abarkuh, which that dossier adds, is not on this page.

notes:
A state Cliopatria lacks (cliopatria_names []). Two pages opened. Wikidata id not obtainable: null.
Territory: only the city of Yazd is named on the pages ('ruled the city of Yazd from approximately 1141 to 1319'), so the dossier draws the same 65 km disc that the kakuyids dossier hands to the atabegs; the kakuyids dossier's Abarkuh disc is not on these pages and is left unassigned after 1141 (flagged for the reviewer).
Status: 'Most of the Atabegs of Yazd were tributaries to the Seljuks and the Mongol Il-Khans' (page, undated): Sam was 'appointed as atabeg by Ahmad Sanjar in 1141'. The vassal events belong to great-seljuk-empire (a 1141 vassal_start; its dossier has none) and ulus-of-hulegu (undated); none is recorded here. The Khwarazmian relation is not on either page. The 1297-1315 'Mongol occupation' is the infobox's entry for those years; the dossier pairs it with ulus-of-hulegu as counterpart on the reading that the Mongols of Iran were the Ilkhanate.
Rulers: Sam's end is 1188 on the list and 1193 (death) on his page.
Not settled: the extent of the realm, the relation with the Salghurids or Kerman (the Marco Polo passage names Kerman as the next kingdom), and the exact year of the Muzaffarid takeover (infobox 1319; muzaffarids dossier 'around 1319').
Gazetteer names used that it lacks: none.
